description: "Pius IX. And His Time" by Æneas MacDonell Dawson is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The work focuses on the life and papacy of Pius IX, detailing the significant events and reforms during his tenure as Pope, which were marked by both ecclesiastical challenges and social transformations.
